title: Andrew Vachss Hard Looks #7 #9 Lot Dark Horse Comics 1993 Crime Noir Fingerman
conditionDescription: Light handling wear on both; #7 has a small bend at the top right corner. See photos.
descriptionText:
Andrew Vachss' Hard Looks #7 and #9 (1993), Dark Horse Comics - crime noir anthology adapting Vachss' short stories. $2.95 cover price each.

- #7: painted doll cover. Back cover: Predator: Race War #0 ad ("Ground Zero!!!")
- #9: Bob Fingerman cover. Back cover: Debut Comics #1 preview ad (Deathmate, She-Bat vs. Spawn, Madman Adventures)

Condition: light handling wear; #7 has a small bend at the top right corner (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
